svg.text: terminal - recommendation: categorical evaluator rejected, numeric one reads the traces
$ agentcore run recommendation --type system-prompt -r aia_uc06 -e currency_guard \
--prompt-file app/aia_uc06/system-prompt.md \
--from-insights baseline_failure_analysis-375c7e1293 -n currency_fix --wait
Error: [EvaluationNotSupportedException] Evaluator 'aiauc06_currency_guard-iBJsElGEmU' returned categorical
labels ['Pass'] instead of numeric scores. Custom evaluators with a categorical rating scale are not supported
for recommendations. Configure your evaluator to return a numeric score.
$ agentcore run recommendation --type system-prompt -r aia_uc06 -e Builtin.Correctness \
--prompt-file app/aia_uc06/system-prompt.md \
--from-insights baseline_failure_analysis-375c7e1293 -n currency_fix3 --wait
✓ Recommendation started: currency_fix3-95A6845AB8 (COMPLETED)
The most pervasive pattern, driving the majority of task-instruction-category-non-compliance and
hallucination-category-hall-misunderstand failures, involved receipts denominated in non-USD currencies. Traces
0009, 0012, 0016, 0005, 0006, 0011, and 0014 all presented receipts with EUR or GBP currency fields. In each
case the agent either silently treated the foreign amount as a USD value, explicitly fabricated a 1:1
equivalence (e.g., asserting "€210.0 = $210.0 in USD"), or acknowledged the mismatch and then approved anyway.
The optimizer traced this to the original prompt's blanket assertion that "every receipt amount is already in
USD," which the agent applied even when the load_receipt tool returned a contradictory currency field. The fix
introduced was a direct rule: when the receipt currency is not USD, the agent must choose "review" and must
never treat a non-USD amount as USD or fabricate an exchange rate.
+++ Recommended System Prompt +++
evidence/62, 67 · pass-fail scales cannot drive optimization; the numeric run cites the EUR/GBP traces
